messages.The selected parts will be returned to t: The selected parts will be returned to their state in the backup and their current state will be overwritten. Continue?

messages.The site address (siteurl/home), Flux Ba: The site address (siteurl/home), Flux Backup settings and the backup list are kept. Plugin and theme folders are replaced with their backed-up version; in other folders files are overwritten.

messages.No backups yet. Take the first one with: No backups yet. Take the first one with "Back up now"; a backup is taken automatically before plugin and theme updates.

messages.Backups are stored in %s. Hostinger does: Backups are stored in %s. Hostinger does not include this folder in its own backups: download important backups to your computer.

messages.Original size: the size of the files on: Original size: the size of the files on the site (for the database, the size of the SQL dump). In archive: the compressed size inside the zip. Images and videos are already compressed, so they do not get smaller in the archive.
messages.The total size of backups never exceeds: The total size of backups never exceeds this: before a new backup, the oldest unlocked backups are deleted. Locked backups are never deleted automatically; if no room can be made, the backup is not taken.
messages.FluxWP packages only (flx-… plugins and: FluxWP packages only (flx-… plugins and FluxWP themes)
messages.In manual, bulk and automatic updates, t: In manual, bulk and automatic updates, the database and the updated package's folder are backed up right before the package is installed. A bulk update produces a single backup.
messages.If the update went fine, the backup is d: If the update went fine, the backup is deleted after this period. Lock the ones you want to keep in the list.
messages.In the site's time zone. Choose night ho: In the site's time zone. Choose night hours; WP-Cron is triggered by visits, so it may run a few minutes late.
messages.Only this many of the latest scheduled b: Only this many of the latest scheduled backups are kept (locked ones are not counted).
messages.Add wp-admin, wp-includes and root files: Add wp-admin, wp-includes and root files (including wp-config.php) to full backups
messages.WordPress core can always be downloaded: WordPress core can always be downloaded again from wordpress.org; leaving it out saves space.
messages.One path per line, relative to the WordP: One path per line, relative to the WordPress root folder. The * wildcard can be used.
messages.Always excluded: the backup folder, wp-s: Always excluded: the backup folder, wp-snapshots, other backup plugins' folders (ai1wm-backups, updraft, wpvividbackups, backups-dup-*), cache, litespeed, upgrade, upgrade-temp-backup.
messages.Back up the current database before rest: Back up the current database before restoring the database (kept for 7 days)
messages.When off (default), deleting the plugin: When off (default), deleting the plugin removes only its settings; the zip files stay in the folder.
